$comment: What's new in Cafe Bazaar for the next version (required: a Bazaar build fails without it). Set version to the version being released (package.json) and write fa and en, on the bazaar branch. Emptied automatically after a release.
fa: داستان مصور تازه، صفحه‌ی لودینگ جدید، قطار و ریل‌های رنگی، گردونه‌ی شانس، ظاهر جدید پنجره‌ها و اجرای سبک‌تر روی گوشی.
en: A new comic story, a new loading screen, colourful trains and rails, a lucky wheel, a new look for popups, and a lighter game on phones.
